verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: You must register a custom OAuth app with Xero because Composio does not provide a managed Xero app.
verdict.cost: Free to develop; financial services or partner programs may incur additional terms or fees

composioFit.summary: Composio does not manage a Xero OAuth app, so you must create a custom auth config by supplying your own Xero Client ID and Client Secret.
whyOwnApp: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for Xero, requiring a bring-your-own-app approach.
Allows you to customize OAuth branding and ensure dedicated API quota.

phases.name: Create Xero Developer Account and App
steps: Go to the Xero Developer portal at https://developer.xero.com/ and sign up or log in.
Create a new application in your Xero developer console.
Retrieve your Client ID and Client Secret.
phases.handoff: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret to configure your Composio auth config.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs
steps: Obtain the redirect URI from your Composio auth config dashboard.
Add the absolute redirect URI into your Xero app settings (wildcards are not supported).

phases.name: Test Authentication and Token Management
steps: Trigger the connect flow through Composio to connect your Xero organisation.
Verify token refresh behavior and ensure refresh tokens are cycled properly before expiration.
phases.handoff: Integration tested against your own Xero account.

artefacts.title: Xero App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
App Name: AI Agent Integration
Company URL: https://yourdomain.com
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

artefacts.title: Privacy Policy & Terms Requirements
artefacts.body: Your apps must include your own legally binding terms of use and privacy policy that are available to any user. Ensure your terms clearly describe how and why you collect, store, use, and share user data.

requirements.label: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
requirements.when: Required for all apps connecting to Xero

requirements.label: Financial Services Approval
requirements.when: If offering financial services such as lending, insurance, bank feeds, payments, or data products/underwriting

redirectRules.rule: Redirection URI must be an absolute URI. Wildcards are not supported.
You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.

blockers.cause: Exceeded the concurrency limit (5 calls), minute limit (60 calls per minute), or daily limit (5000 calls per tenant per day).
blockers.fix: Respect the Retry-After http header, combine updates into fewer requests, or optimize API usage.
blockers.fallback: Implement request batching and backoff logic.

blockers.cause: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days, or the 30-minute grace period following a failed refresh has elapsed.
blockers.fix: Send the user through the authorization flow again to obtain a new code.
blockers.fallback: Prompt the user to re-authenticate via the Composio connection link.

blockers.cause: Using API Data sourced from the Xero developer platform to train or fine-tune artificial intelligence models including LLMs.
blockers.fix: Ensure no Xero API Data is used for training or fine-tuning AI models.
blockers.fallback: Remove any data pipelines feeding Xero data into model training sets.

checklist.text: Register for a Xero developer account on the Xero Developer portal.
Create your OAuth app in the Xero developer console and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
Get the redirect URI from your Composio auth config and add it to your Xero app settings.
Publish legally binding terms of use and a privacy policy for your app.
Initiate an OAuth flow via Composio to test connection and token exchanges.

uncertainties: Exact UI field names inside the Xero developer app creation form beyond standard Client ID/Secret and Redirect URIs.
Exact manual review turnaround time for general apps, as the documentation emphasizes terms and limits rather than a formal review SLA.
